profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
17 years of software engineering experience in finance, loan servicing, inventory, marketplaces and other enterprise software. 

Co-founded and successfully exited from SaaS utility billing company MuniBilling. 

Demonstrated exceptional ability to form and lead high performing software engineering teams from early stage startups to midsize companies.

Co-organizer of first Web Assembly meetup in California: https://www.meetup.com/WebAssembly-blockchain-Open-Web-WABO

Publishing on Medium: https://medium.com/@jharris.sf

https://github.com/jharris-code

jharris.sf@gmail.com

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Providing expert advice and services on Ethereum smart contracts (solidity), decentralized architecture, Javascript, React/Node, Python, Ruby on Rails, AWS, Google API's.

positions.description:

On behalf of Semada Research Institute.

company.name: Non-Fungible Summit - San Francisco Blockchain Collective

positions.title: Co-Founder / CTO
positions.description:
Co-Founded MuniBilling, a SaaS utility billing platform used by hundreds of local government and private entities in the US, Canada and U.K. Acquired in 2016.

- Oversaw 5 consecutive years of substantial revenue growth
- Architected all areas of system
- Built engineering team and lead software development
- Product Management and Sales Engineering
- Developed relationships and architected integrations with payment processors and gateways including Heartland and Vantiv.
- Managed and negotiated vendor contracts
- Managed early stage growth to successfully support clients with 99.999% uptime
- Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Rackspace, Javascript, JQuery.

positions.title: Consultant - Software Development
positions.description:
- Re-joined DriveTime engineering team on a consulting basis to help solve difficult technical issues and speed delivery of application development.
- Microsoft ASP.NET (C#), Javascript, JQuery

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated as an early stage engineer in Prosper's development of their P2P loan marketplace
- Designed and developed in Microsoft ASP.NET (C#), Javascript, JQuery
- Utilized SOA
- Full stack software engineer
- Consistently delivered stable code for frequent releases
- Lead implementation of Agile software development methodology with engineering team

positions.title: Application Developer III/Technical Team Lead
positions.description:
- Collaborated during my tenure on several teams oriented to functional business area including Inventory, Sales, Loan Servicing
- Helped team transition from Waterfall to Agile software development methodology
- Designed and developed applications in Microsoft .NET (C#)
- Full stack application development in both Windows thick client and web
- Service Oriented Architecture leveraged to make data available to many business applications
- Focused on the successful delivery of stable, functional applications and services that served the internal business users

positions.title: Software Developer at Security Trust Co.
positions.description:
- Designed Windows and Web applications for mutual fund trading system
- Core system required processing of 10's of thousands of trade transactions through mutual fund companies on a nightly basis to satisfy Private Client Services accounts
- Designed trading application within traditional waterfall project methodology
- Worked closely with business owners and analysts to refine requirements
- Supported trading system after successful release
- Create Functional and Technical Design specifications
- Design stored procedures, views, user defined functions in SQL 2000
- Technologies: VB.Net, C#, 1.1/2.0 frameworks, ASP 3.0, XML, Web Services ASMX

positions.title: Web Developer at Momentum Interactive Consulting Agency
positions.description:
- Website design and enhancements for multiple clients
- Created CRM portal websites
- Created stored procedures, ASP 3.0 web pages for SQL 97/2000
- Utilized ASP 3.0, .net 1.0/1.1, SQL 97/2000, HTML, XML
